article.story: BUFFALO, N.Y. -- — Ari Fulton’s 18 points helped St. Bonaventure defeat Canisius 88-49 on Saturday. Fulton added eight rebounds for the Bonnies (1-1). Zach Philipkoski hit four 3-pointers and scored 16. Akbar Waheed III had 10 points. Michael Wilson Jr. led the way for the Golden Griffins (0-2) with nine points. St. Bonaventure took the lead for good with 19:42 left in the first half. The score was 43-14 at halftime. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
